name: Living Legends: Frozen Beauty
storyline: The Queen has chosen your sister as her successor, but are her promises too good to be true? You were only six when your mother vanished, leaving you to care for your younger sister, Elizabeth. After she receives an invitation naming her as the Queen's successor, she pleads with you to join her in her new royal life. All she has to do is pass a simple test to prove her worth. Is this too good to be true, or is your luck finally changing? There are many secrets awaiting you in the Queen's castle, but the biggest dangers lie beneath the icy mountain passes in Living Legends: Frozen Beauty, a chilling Hidden-Object Adventure game.
summary: Living Legends: Frozen Beauty is the 2nd installment of Living Legends Series by 4Friends Games. The game is based loosely on the tale of Snow White. In 2020, the game receives a remastered version, with an increase in story content, updated graphics, alteration in some of the gameplay, and additional soundtracks.
